qe: In which year was the 'Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana' (PMJDY) launched?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना' (PMJDY) किस वर्ष शुरू की गई थी?
e: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) ki shuruaat 2014 mein hui thi tatha yahi desh ka sabse bada vitti samaveshan (financial inclusion) abhiyan hai; ismein zero balance par bank khata tatha RuPay card milta hai. Isme yahi soch chhupi hai ki us samay aadhi se zyada aabadi bank se bahar thi, isliye yojana ke tehat khate kholkar sarkari sahayata seedha labharti ke khate mein pahunchai jaati hai; aaj isse jude khate 50 crore se adhik hain.2013 tatha 2015 ke aankde is abhiyan ke shuruaati varsh nahi hain, kyunki khate kholne ka ye kaam 2014 mein shuru hua tha. Exam point: PM Jan Dhan Yojana 2014 mein shuru hui - yahi desh ka sabse bada vitti samaveshan abhiyan hai.

qe: What is the primary objective of 'Ujjwala Yojana'?
qh: 'उज्ज्वला योजना' का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: Ujjwala yojana ka mukhya uddeshya BPL parivaron ki mahilaon ko dhuein wale chulhe ki jagah LPG connection dena hai; ismein bina deposit LPG connection, pehla refill tatha chulha bina paise ke milta hai. Yah zaroori tha kyunki chulhe ka dhuan mahilaon ke phephron tatha aankhon ko hani pahunchata hai, isliye saaf indhan milne se unka swasthya tatha bacha hua samay dono unke kaam aata hai; isse jangal par bhi dabaav kam hota hai. Har ghar bijli, muft shiksha ya saur urja wale vikalp is yojana ke sahi uddeshya nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: Ujjwala yojana ka uddeshya BPL gharanaon ki mahilaon ko LPG connection dena hai - isse dhuein wala pradushan ghat ta hai.

qe: Which scheme aims to provide a tap water connection to every rural household by 2024?
qh: कौन सी योजना 2024 तक हर ग्रामीण घर में नल का जल कनेक्शन प्रदान करने का लक्ष्य रखती है?
e: Jal Jeevan Mission ka lakshya 2024 tak har grameen ghar tak nal ka saaf paani pahunchana hai; ise 2019 mein aarambh kiya gaya tatha yahi Hari Ghar Nal se Jal ka sapna poora karta hai. Iska asli kaaran yahi nikalta hai ki gaon ki mahilaon ko door se paani laane mein ghante lagte the tatha gande paani se bimariyan failti hain, isliye ghar tak nal pahunchne se samay tatha bimaari dono bachti hain; ismein paani ki gunvatta ki jaanch par bhi dhyan diya jaata hai. Atal Bhujal bhujal (groundwater) ke prabandhan par, Namami Gange nadi ki safai par tatha Swachh Bharat safai par kaam karta hai, isliye ye teeno alag vishay hain. Exam point: 2024 tak har grameen ghar tak nal ka connection dene wala mission Jal Jeevan Mission hai - yahi paani ki gunvatta bhi dekhta hai.

qe: The 'PM-KISAN' scheme provides how much financial assistance annually to farmers?
qh: 'PM-KISAN' योजना किसानों को सालाना कितनी वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करती है?
e: PM-KISAN yojana ke tehat chhote tatha seemit kisaanon ko har saal 6,000 rupaye teen kishron mein sarkari sahayata milti hai; ise 2019 se lagu kiya gaya tha tatha rakam khate mein DBT ke zariye pahunchti hai. Iske pichhe yahi soch hai ki kheti ka kharch beej tatha khaad par bade paimane par lagta hai, isliye thodi sahayata se kisaan ko karz lene ki majboori kam padti hai; do hektare tak ki zameen wale kisan iske patra hote hain.2,000 tatha 8,000 ke aankde kisi anya sahayata ke hain, isliye kisaan ki varshik sahayata ke liye yahi sahi rakam 6,000 hai. Exam point: PM-KISAN yojana se kisaanon ko saalana 6,000 rupaye milte hain - yahi teen kishron mein DBT se pahunchte hain.

qe: What is the full form of 'MUDRA' in the PMMY scheme?
qh: PMMY योजना में 'MUDRA' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
o: Medium Units Development and Rural Agency
Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency
e: MUDRA ka poora roop Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency hai tatha PMMY ke tehat chhote karobar ko bina gearan (collateral) takri 10 lakh rupaye tak ka karz milta hai. Iska kaaran bhi yahi hota hai ki chhote udyami ke paas bank ka gearan rakhne layak sampatti nahi hoti, isliye uski jagah udyami ki pehchaan tatha vyavsay ke aadhaar par karz diya jaata hai; isse naye rozgar tatha aatmanirbharata badhti hai. Medium Units Development and Rural Agency tatha Money Under Digital Reform Agency jaise naam kisi sarkari paribhasha mein nahi milte, isliye yahi poora roop sahi hai. Exam point: MUDRA ka poora roop Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency hai - iske tehat chhote karobar ko 10 lakh tak karz milta hai.

qe: Under 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao', which ministry is the primary nodal agency?
qh: 'बेटी बचाओ बेटी पढ़ाओ' के तहत प्राथमिक नोडल मंत्रालय कौन सा है?
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
e: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao andolan ke tehat betiyon ke janm, unki suraksha tatha unki padhai par dhyan diya jaata hai; iska pehla uddeshya ling anupat (sex ratio) sudharna tha, jiske liye Swasthya, Shiksha tatha Mahila-evam-Bal Vikas teenon mantralay saath kaam karte hain. Yahi baat ise khaas banati hai ki ladkiyon ki sankhya kam rehne tatha unhe school na bheje jaane se desh ki aadhi takat peeche reh jaati hai, isliye kendra tatha rajya sarkaren milkar prachar tatha punya rashi yojanaon ke zariye ishe aage badhati hain. Sirf ek mantralay ka naam dena is andolan ka poora chitra nahi de paata, isliye aise vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao mein Swasthya, Shiksha tatha Mahila-evam-Bal Vikas teenon mantralay shamil hain - yahi iske sabhi ange bataata hai.

qe: What is the maximum loan limit under the 'Tarun' category of MUDRA Yojana?
qh: मुद्रा योजना की 'तरुण' श्रेणी के तहत अधिकतम ऋण सीमा क्या है?
e: Mudra yojana mein tarun shreni ke tehat karz ki adhiktam seema 10 lakh rupaye hai; iske alawa shishu (50,000 tak), kishor (5 lakh tak) tatha tarun-plus (10 lakh se adhik) shreniyaan hoti hain. Iska mool kaaran yahi hai ki udyami ke karobar ki sthiti ke hisaab se alag-alag shreni banane se bina gearan karz aasaani se milta hai tatha Pehla charan (shishu) mein chhote karobar se jude log bhi bank vyavastha mein aa jaate hain.50,000 shishu shreni ka tatha 5 lakh kishor shreni ka aankda hai, isliye tarun ke liye 10 lakh hi sahi seema hai. Exam point: MUDRA yojana ki tarun shreni mein 10 lakh rupaye ki seema tak karz diya jaata hai - yahi bina gearan diya jaata hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to improve the health of adolescent girls and pregnant women through nutrition?
qh: पोषण के माध्यम से किशोरियों और गर्भवती महिलाओं के स्वास्थ्य में सुधार के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: POSHAN Abhiyaan ka dhyan gaaon mein kishoriyon, garbhvati mahilaon tatha chhote bachon ke poshan (nutrition) sudharne par hai; iske tehat anganwadi kendraon ke zariye khurak, poshan pakhwada tatha vaazan (weight) ki nigrani hoti hai. Iske liye yahi tark kaam karta hai ki kam vaazan tatha khoon ki kami wale bachon ka dimaag tatha shareer theek se nahi badhta, isliye yahi mission maa-bachche ke pehle 1000 dino tatha kishori avastha par khaas dhyan deta hai. SAGAR samundri sahyog, UJALA bijli ki bachat tatha PRASAD tirth sthalon ke sudhar se juda hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: POSHAN Abhiyaan kishoriyon tatha garbhvati mahilaon ke poshan sudhar se juda hai - yahi anganwadi ke zariye chalta hai.

qe: The 'Saubhagya' scheme is related to which sector?
qh: 'सौभाग्य' योजना किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
e: Saubhagya yojana ka sambandh grameen vidyutikaran se hai; iska lakshya har ghar tak bijli ka connection pahunchana tatha us par solar panel, sooraj plate tatha LED bulb jaisi suvidha dena tha. Iska seedha kaaran yahi hai ki andhere mein padhai tatha kaam par asar padta hai, isliye bijli pahunchne se gaon mein chhoti udyog tatha padhai dono ko bal milta hai; ismein connection ka kharch bhi sarkar uthaati hai. Uchch shiksha, kaushal vikas tatha khana pakane ki gas ka kaam anya yojanaon ka hai, isliye grameen vidyutikaran hi is yojana ka vishay hai. Exam point: Saubhagya yojana grameen vidyutikaran se judi hai - yahi har ghar tak bijli ka connection pahunchati hai.

qe: What is the age limit for the 'Atal Pension Yojana' (APY)?
qh: 'अटल पेंशन योजना' (APY) के लिए आयु सीमा क्या है?
e: Atal Pension Yojana mein 18 se 40 varsh ki aayu ke log shamil ho sakte hain tatha 60 varsh ki umar ke baad nishchit mahine ki pension milti hai; ise asangathit kshetra ke karmachariyon ke liye banaya gaya tha. Yahi wajah hai jis se ki kam aay wale logon ke paas budhape ke liye bachat nahi hoti, isliye sarkar unke yogdan ka aadhaar dekar unhe pension deti hai; 18 varsh se pehle ya 40 varsh ke baad pravesh manzoor nahi hai. Aayu ki koi seema na hona galat hai tatha 21 se 50 varsh ka daayra kisi anya yojana ka hai, isliye 18 se 40 varsh hi sahi hai. Exam point: APY mein pravesh ki aayu 18 se 40 varsh hai - yahi asangathit karmachari ke liye bani yojana hai.

qe: Which scheme was replaced by the 'Ayushman Bharat - PMJAY'?
qh: 'आयुष्मान भारत - PMJAY' द्वारा किस योजना को प्रतिस्थापित किया गया था?
e: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY) se pehle Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY) chalti thi, jismein kuchh rajya sahayata dete the; PM-JAY ne usi purani vyavastha ki jagah le kar ek hi raashtriya cover khada kiya. Isme yahi baat chhupi hai ki purani yojana mein cover kam tatha saare rajya shamil nahi the, isliye ek hi panch lakh wala cover tatha do tatha teessre star ke aspatal ka kharch jod dena zyada faydemand tha. Mission Indradhanush teekakaran tatha Janani Suraksha Yojana prasav sahayata se judi hai, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: Ayushman Bharat - PMJAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana) ne RSBY ki jagah li - purani RSBY yojana ka cover bahut kam tha tatha PMJAY ka cover 5 lakh rupaye ka hai.

qe: What is the insurance cover provided per family under 'Ayushman Bharat - PMJAY'?
qh: 'आयुष्मान भारत - PMJAY' के तहत प्रति परिवार कितना बीमा कवर दिया जाता है?
e: Ayushman Bharat ke tehat patra parivar ke har saal ka ilaj paanch lakh rupaye ki seema tak sarkar uthaati hai; aspatal mein bharti hone par patient ko cash nahi dena padta. Iska mukhya aadhaar yahi hai ki bade ilaj ka kharch sadharan parivar ko garibi mein dhakel deta tha, isliye yahi cover pura desh mein ek jaise laagu kiya gaya tatha ise pandrah varsh tak chalkar 70 varsh se adhik umar wale bhi ab ismein shamil hain. Do lakh tatha das lakh ke cover anya yojanaon ke hain; yahan paanch lakh ki seema hi sahi hai. Exam point: Ayushman Bharat wale parivar ko saal bhar mein paanch lakh rupaye tak ka ilaaj muft milta hai - aspatal mein bharti par cash dena nahi padta.

qe: Which scheme aims at the transformation of 115 backward districts in India?
qh: भारत में 115 पिछड़े जिलों के परिवर्तन के उद्देश्य से कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई है?
e: Aspirational Districts Programme ke tehat desh ke pakau (pichhde) 112 jilaon ko tez vikas ke raaste par laana hai; ismein swasthya, shiksha, kheti, aadhaar jaisi suvidha tatha buniyaad dhanche jaisa soochak (indicator) dekha jaata hai. Iska kaaran bhi yahi hota hai ki kuchh jila bihar jaisi sthiti mein peeche reh gaye the, isliye har jile ke liye alag lakshya tay karke saamuhik pratispardha (competition) ke zariye tez badlav laaya jaata hai; NITI Aayog iski nigrani karta hai. Smart Cities tatha AMRUT shehri suvidhaon se juda hai tatha HRIDAY dharohar sthalon se, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Aspirational Districts Programme pichhde jilaon ke tez vikas ke liye hai - yahi NITI Aayog ki nigrani mein chalta hai.

qe: The 'Stand-Up India' scheme promotes entrepreneurship among which groups?
qh: 'स्टैंड-अप इंडिया' योजना किन समूहों के बीच उद्यमिता को बढ़ावा देती है?
e: Stand-Up India yojana SC/ST tatha mahila udyamiyon ko kam se kam 10 lakh tatha adhiktam 1 crore rupaye ka karz dekar unka apna udyog shuru karne mein madad karti hai; ise 2016 mein shuruaat hui thi. Iske liye yahi soch rakhi gayi ki arkshit tatha mahila varg ke logon ke paas punji ki kami hoti hai, isliye yahi yojana unhe har zile mein kam se kam ek naye udyog ke liye karz tatha prashikshan deti hai. Sirf kisaan, retired soldiers tatha bekar yuva iske labharthi nahi hain, isliye SC/ST tatha mahilaon ka varg hi sahi hai. Exam point: Stand-Up India yojana SC/ST tatha mahilaon ke udyog ke liye hai - ismein 10 lakh se 1 crore tak ka karz milta hai.

qe: What does the 'A' in the 'AMRUT' scheme stand for?
qh: 'AMRUT' योजना में 'A' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: AMRUT yojana ka poora naam Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation hai; ismein shehri kshetra mein paani ki aapoorti, drain (sewerage) tatha hari-kshetra (green space) jaisi suvidhaon ka sudhar hota hai. Yahi baat isme jaan lene yogya hai ki badhte shahar mein naali tatha paani ki vyavastha kam pad jaati hai, isliye yahi mission shehron ko rehne yogya banane par kaam karta hai; iska 'A' Atal hi hai. Action, Agricultural tatha Aspirational ke vistaar is yojana ke naam ke akshar nahi hain, isliye Atal hi sahi arth hai. Exam point: AMRUT mein 'A' ka arth Atal hai - yahi shehri paani tatha drainage sudhar ka mission hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide free LED bulbs to domestic consumers?
qh: घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को मुफ्त/रियायती एलईडी बल्ब प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Ghar ka utpadak (household) consumer ko sasta tatha achhi gunvatta wala LED bulb dene ke liye UJALA yojana chalayi gayi; ismein purane bulb wapas le kar naye LED diye jaate the. Iska sabse bada kaaran yahi hai ki LED bulb bijli tatha bulb ki umar dono bachata hai, isliye yahi yojana ghar ke bijli bill tatha desh ki urja mang dono ko ghatati hai; iska kaam EESL dekh raha hai. SAUBHAGYA grameen vidyutikaran, UJJWALA rasoi gas tatha PAHAL gas par DBT se juda hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: sasti LED bulb dene wali yojana UJALA hai - yahi ghar ke bijli bill tatha urja mang ko ghatati hai.

qe: The 'HRIDAY' scheme is associated with which of the following?
qh: 'HRIDAY' योजना निम्नलिखित में से किससे संबंधित है?
e: HRIDAY yojana ka poora naam Heritage City Development and Augmentation Yojana hai tatha ye dharohar wale shahron ki suraksha, safai tatha saundaryikaran se judi hai; ismein Ajmer, Amritsar, Varanasi, Badami, Dwaraka, Gaya, Kanchipuram, Mathura, Puri, Velankanni, Warangal jaisi jagah shamil thi. Iske pichhe yahi soch kaam karti hai ki purani imaarton tatha galion ke theek hone se wahan aane wale paryatak badhte hain, isliye yahi shehron ki aay tatha lok-sanskriti dono ko bachaata hai. Highway ka vikas, dil ki bimaari ka ilaj tatha grameen aawas ka kaam anya yojanaon ka hai, isliye yahi yojana dharohar wale shahar chunti hai. Exam point: HRIDAY yojana dharohar wale shahron ke vikas se judi hai - yahi purani imaarton tatha galion ke sudhar par kaam karti hai.

qe: Which mission aims to achieve 'Housing for All' in urban areas by 2022?
qh: किस मिशन का लक्ष्य 2022 तक शहरी क्षेत्रों में 'सभी के लिए आवास' प्राप्त करना है?
e: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) ka lakshya 2022 tak shehron mein sabhi ke liye pukka ghar dena tha; iske tehat EWS tatha LIG vargon ke liye bina byaj ya kam byaj ka karz tatha building banane mein sahayata milti hai. Iska praathamik kaaran yahi hai ki shehron mein jhopdi tatha kachche ghar mein rehne wale logon ke paas ghar khareedne ka dhan nahi hota, isliye byaj par subsidy dekar unhe pukka ghar dilaya jaata hai. DAY-NULM aajeevika se, AMRUT shehri paani se tatha PMAY-G grameen awas se juda hai, isliye shehri kshetra ka aawas mission hi sahi naam hai. Exam point: shehri kshetra mein sabhi ke liye aawas wali yojana PMAY-U hai - yahi byaj par subsidy deti hai.

qe: What is the maximum interest rate subsidy for EWS/LIG under PMAY-U?
qh: PMAY-U के तहत EWS/LIG के लिए अधिकतम ब्याज सब्सिडी क्या है?
e: PMAY-U ke tehat kam aay wale varg tatha laghu aay varg ke labharthiyon ke liye karz par adhiktam 6.5 pratishat byaj subsidy milti hai; iska labh aise parivaron ko milta hai jo pehli baar ghar kharid rahe hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hai ki mahine ki bhugtan (EMI) sasti ho jaane par sarkari suvidha wale ghar khareedna aasaani se sambhav ho jaata hai tatha naye ghar banane ka kaam tez hota hai. 3, 4.5 ya 9 pratishat wale aankde is yojana ki sahi subsidy nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PMAY-U mein EWS tatha LIG ke liye adhiktam 6.5 pratishat byaj subsidy milti hai - yahi sasti EMI se pukka ghar dilaati hai.

qe: Under 'Mission Indradhanush', how many vaccine-preventable diseases were initially targeted?
qh: 'मिशन इंद्रधनुष' के तहत शुरू में कितनी बीमारियों को लक्षित किया गया था?
e: Mission Indradhanush ke tehat shuruaat mein 7 bimaariyon ke khilaf tikakaran ka lakhya rakha gaya tha, jaise diphtheria, kaali khaansi, tetanus, polio, khasa, halki khaansi tatha TB; baad mein yahi daayra badha kar 12 kiya gaya. Iska asli tark yahi hai ki jinke teeke nahi lagte, unke bachche in bimaariyon se jaldi shikar hote hain, isliye yahi mission chhoot gaye bachon tatha mahilaon tak teeka pahunchane par kaam karta hai.5, 10 tatha 12 ke aankde baad ki soochi ke hain, kyunki shuruaat mein 7 bimaariyan hi lakhya thi. Exam point: Mission Indradhanush mein shuruaat mein 7 bimaariyon ko lakhya kiya gaya - yahi khoob teeka lagne ka abhiyan hai.

qe: The 'Sovereign Gold Bond' scheme was launched in which year?
qh: 'सॉवरेन गोल्ड बॉन्ड' योजना किस वर्ष शुरू की गई थी?
e: Sovereign Gold Bond yojana 2015 mein shuru hui thi, jismein sarkar ne sone ke gramon ke hisaab se prathibhutiyan jaari ki; inhe khareedne par sone ke bhaav tatha upar se 2.5 pratishat salana byaj milta hai. Iska kaaran bhi yahi hota hai ki log sone mein bahut dhan lagate hain tatha bahar se aayat sone ka bojh desh par padta hai, isliye bina sone ko ghar le aaye nivesh karne ka yahi rasta banaya gaya; bhugtan ke waqt sone ka rate milta hai.2014 tatha 2017 ke saal is bond ke jaari hone ke saal nahi hain, kyunki shuruaat 2015 mein hui thi. Exam point: Sovereign Gold Bond yojana 2015 mein shuru hui - ismein sone ke bhaav ke saath 2.5 pratishat salana byaj milta hai.

qe: What is the primary goal of the 'Skill India' mission?
qh: 'स्किल इंडिया' मिशन का मुख्य लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Training 40 crore people in various skills by 2022
e: Skill India Mission ka aisa lakhya rakha gaya ki 2022 tak 40 crore logon ko kai tarah ke kaushal (skill) sikhaye jaayein, taaki unhe kaam tatha aay mile; iske tehat kaushal vikas mantralay ne Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana shuru ki. Yahi soch iske pichhe hai ki bahut logon ke paas degree hoti hai par kaam karne ka hunar nahi hota, isliye prashikshan se unki rozgar-yogyata badhti hai tatha udyogon ko tayyar manchahi majdoor milte hain. Kheti ka paidavar badhana, muft laptop ya school ki imaaratein is mission ke sahi uddeshya nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Skill India Mission ka lakhya 2022 tak 40 crore logon ko kaushal dena tha - yahi unhe rozgar-yogy banata hai.

qe: The 'Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM' is related to?
qh: 'दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - NRLM' किससे संबंधित है?
e: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM ka sambandh grameen aajeevika tatha garibi hataane se hai tatha yahi Aajeevika Mission hai; iske tehat gaon ki mahilaon ke swayn sahayata samuh tatha unke rojgaar ke liye karz jaisi suvidhaen di jaati hain. Isme yahi tark lagta hai ki gaon ke gaareeb ko laagat tatha prashikshan se jodkar uski aay badhai jaati hai, isliye yahi mission grameen udyog tatha aajeevika ko sahara deta hai. Shehri aawas, niryat badhawa ya antariksh anusandhan iske sahi vishay nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: DAY-NRLM grameen aajeevika tatha garibi hataane se juda hai - yahi gaon ki mahilaon ke samuhon ko karz tatha prashikshan deta hai.

qe: Which scheme provides an annual insurance cover of Rs. 2 Lakh for accidental death for a premium of Rs. 20?
qh: 20 रुपये के प्रीमियम पर दुर्घटना मृत्यु के लिए 2 लाख रुपये का बीमा कवर कौन सी योजना प्रदान करती है?
e: PMSBY yojana mein keval 20 rupaye salana prem dekar durghatna (accident) se mrityu tatha purn viklangata par 2 lakh rupaye tatha aadhi viklangata par 1 lakh rupaye ka beema milta hai; ise 2015 mein chalaya gaya. Iska mukhya tark yahi hai ki kam aay wale parivaron ko achanak hone wala hadsa tak aarthik roop se barbaad kar deta hai, isliye bahut kam prem par bada cover dene se unhe sahara milta hai. APY pension se, PMJJBY jeevan beema se tatha Ayushman Bharat ilaj ke kharch se juda hai, isliye durghatna wala cover PMSBY hi deti hai. Exam point: 20 rupaye ke prem par durghatna mrityu ke liye 2 lakh ka cover PMSBY deti hai - yahi bahut kam prem wala durghatna beema hai.

qe: The 'PAHAL' scheme is related to which of the following?
qh: 'पहल' (PAHAL) योजना निम्नलिखित में से किससे संबंधित है?
e: PAHAL yojana LPG ke silindar par Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) se judi hai; ismein grahak bazaar ke bhau par silindar leta hai tatha subsidy uske bank khate mein alag se pahunchti hai. Iske andar yahi soch hai ki is vyavastha se nakli tatha duplicate connectionon par lagam lagti hai tatha khuli vijay me kal ka sahi srot khada hota hai, isliye yahi yojana desh ki sabse badi DBT yojanaon mein gini jaati hai. Nadiyon ki safai, betiyon ki padhai tatha sasta aawas anya yojanaon ke vishay hain, isliye LPG par DBT hi is yojana ka kaam hai. Exam point: PAHAL yojana LPG par DBT se judi hai - ismein subsidy seedha bank khate mein aati hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched for the holistic development of villages by MPs?
qh: सांसदों द्वारा गांवों के समग्र विकास के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY) ke tehat har sansad apne kshetra ke ek gaon ko godh (adopt) lekar uske samagra vikas ka zimma lega; ise 2014 mein shuruaat hui thi. Iska pahla kaaran yahi hai ki jansankhya nachh ko khada karke gram panchayat, saaf-safai, shiksha tatha swasthya jaise kshetron mein badlav laya ja sakta hai, isliye yahi yojana lok pratinidhi tatha janata ke beech seedha rishta banati hai. MGNREGA majdoori ki guarantee, PMGSY grameen sadak tatha PMAY-G grameen aawas se juda hai, isliye gaon ke samagra vikas wali yojana SAGY hi hai. Exam point: gaon ke samagra vikas ke liye SAGY yojana sansadon dwara chalayi jaati hai - ismein har sansad ek gaon godh leta hai.

qe: What is the primary focus of the 'KUSUM' scheme?
qh: 'कुसुम' (KUSUM) योजना का मुख्य फोकस क्या है?
e: PM-KUSUM yojana ka mukhya dhyan kisaanon ke liye saur pump tatha bagar zameen par saur plant lagwana hai; isse sinchai sasti padti hai tatha bachi hui bijli bikar aay ka srot banti hai. Iska ek aur kaaran yahi hai ki diesel se chalne wala pump kisaan ki jeb tatha paryavaran dono par bojh daalta hai, isliye saur urja par jaane se kisaan ka kharch tatha paryavaran par bojh dono kam hote hain. Grameen sadak, betiyon ki muft shiksha tatha daigital saksharta ke kaam anya yojanaon ke hain, isliye kisaanon ke saur pump hi is yojana ka dhyan hain. Exam point: KUSUM yojana ka dhyan kisaanon ke saur pump par hai - yahi sasti sinchai tatha extra aay deta hai.

qe: The 'SVAMITVA' scheme is launched for which purpose?
qh: 'स्वामित्व' (SVAMITVA) योजना किस उद्देश्य के लिए शुरू की गई है?
o: Mapping of rural inhabited lands using drones
e: SVAMITVA yojana ke tehat drone ki sahayata se gaon ki aabadi wali zameen ka naksheband (mapping) kar uske sampatti card diye jaate hain, taaki gaon mein har ghar ki zameen ka saaf record bane. Iska nirnayak kaaran yahi hai ki bina naksha tatha sarkari record ke zameen par karz lena tatha vivaad nipatana mushkil hota hai, isliye sampatti card milne par gaon ke log bank se karz le sakte hain tatha jhagde kam hote hain. Buzurgon ki pension, MSME ko karz tatha khiladiyon ka prashikshan anya yojanaon se juda hai, isliye drone se naksha banane wala kaam hi SVAMITVA ka hai. Exam point: SVAMITVA yojana drone se gaon ki zameen ka naksheband karke sampatti card deti hai - isse karz lene tatha jhagde nipatane mein aasaani hoti hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide pensions to small and marginal farmers above the age of 60?
qh: 60 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के छोटे और सीमांत किसानों को पेंशन प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: PM-KMY (Kisan Maandhan Yojana) ke tehat 60 varsh se adhik umar ke chhote tatha seemant kisaanon ko 3,000 rupaye mahine ki pension milti hai; ismein 18 se 40 varsh ke kisan shamil ho sakte hain tatha yogdan ke aadhaar par sarkar bhi barabar rakam daalti hai. Iska kaaran bhi yahi hota hai ki budhape mein kisaan ke paas bachat nahi hoti, isliye thoda-thoda yogdan lekar badhape ki tay aay ka intezaam kiya jaata hai. Atal Pension Yojana asangathit karmachari ke liye, PM-KISAN sahayata ke liye tatha KUSUM saur pump ke liye hai, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: PM-KMY chhote tatha seemant kisaanon ko 60 varsh ke baad pension deti hai - ismein sarkar bhi barabar yogdan deti hai.

qe: What is the age criteria to join the 'Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana' (PMJJBY)?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री जीवन ज्योति बीमा योजना' (PMJJBY) में शामिल होने के लिए आयु मानदंड क्या है?
e: PMJJBY mein shamil hone ke liye 18 se 50 varsh ki aayu honi chahiye; ye jeevan beema yojana kisi bhi karan hone wali mrityu par 2 lakh rupaye ka cover deti hai. Iske liye yahi aadhaar rakha gaya ki kam aay wale parivar ke mukhiya ki achanak mrityu se poora parivar barbaad ho jaata hai, isliye halka prem tatha bada cover hi iski pehchaan hai.18 se 70 tatha 21 se 60 ke daayre kisi anya yojana ke hain, isliye 18 se 50 varsh hi sahi niyam hai. Exam point: PMJJBY mein pravesh ki aayu 18 se 50 varsh hai - yahi kisi bhi karan hone wali mrityu par 2 lakh ka cover deti hai.

qe: What is the annual premium for 'Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana' (PMJJBY) as of 2022?
qh: 2022 तक 'प्रधानमंत्री जीवन ज्योति बीमा योजना' (PMJJBY) का वार्षिक प्रीमियम क्या है?
e: PMJJBY ka varshik prem 436 rupaye hai tatha ise khate se seedha auto-debit kiya jaata hai; is yojana mein 2 lakh rupaye tak ka jeevan beema cover milta hai. Iska kendriya kaaran yahi hai ki bahut chhoti rakam ke prem par bada cover dene se har varg ke paas beema pahunch paata hai, isliye yahi jeevan jyoti yojana garib parivar ki suraksha ka sabse sasta zariya maani jaati hai.330, 20 tatha 12 rupaye anya yojanaon ke prem hain, isliye PMJJBY ka varshik prem 436 rupaye hi hai. Exam point: PMJJBY ka varshik prem 436 rupaye hai - ismein 2 lakh ka jeevan beema cover milta hai.

qe: Which scheme aims to provide high-speed broadband to all Gram Panchayats?
qh: किस योजना का लक्ष्य सभी ग्राम पंचायतों को हाई-स्पीड ब्रॉडबैंड प्रदान करना है?
e: BharatNet mission ka lakhya sabhi gram panchayat tak optical fibre pahunchakar high speed broadband dena hai; ise pehle NOFN ke naam se jaana jaata tha tatha Universal Service Obligation Fund aur CSC se sahayata milti hai. Yahi soch iske andar kaam karti hai ki internet pahunchne se gaon mein padhai, daigital bhugtan tatha sarkari sevaen aasaani se milti hain, isliye yahi mission gaon tatha shahar ke beech daigital antar ghatata hai. PM-WANI chhote dukano par wifi se, Digital India poore programme se tatha SAGAR samundri sahyog se juda hai, isliye ye anya kaam hai. Exam point: BharatNet mission gram panchayat tak high speed broadband pahunchata hai - yahi daigital antar ghatata hai.

qe: The 'PM-CARES' fund was primarily created for which purpose?
qh: 'PM-CARES' फंड मुख्य रूप से किस उद्देश्य के लिए बनाया गया था?
o: Combating the COVID-19 pandemic and similar distress
e: PM-CARES fund mukhya roop se COVID-19 jaisi mahamari se ladne tatha aisi kisi anya vipatti ke samay zaroori sahayata dene ke liye banaya gaya tha; ismein log tatha kamniyan daan kar sakte hain. Isme yahi vajah kaam karti hai ki achanak aane wali aisi mahamari mein bade paimane par aspatal, thaliya tatha teeka banane ka kharch hota hai, isliye ek alag aapatkalin kosh banane se madad tezi se pahunchai ja sakti hai. Antariksh mission, shiksha sudhar ya kheti subsidy is kosh ke sahi uddeshya nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: PM-CARES fund COVID-19 jaisi mahamari tatha vipatti se ladne ke liye banaya gaya tha - ismein daan se madad jutaayi jaati hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide credit to street vendors for their businesses?
qh: रेहड़ी-पटरी वालों (स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स) को उनके व्यवसाय के लिए ऋण प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: PM SVANidhi yojana rehdi-patri wale (street vendors) ko unke vyavsay ke liye karz deti hai; ismein shuru mein 10,000 rupaye ka karz bina gearan milta hai tatha samay par chukane par aage 20,000 tatha 50,000 rupaye tak badhta jaata hai. Iska saaf tark yahi hai ki talab wale ke paas gearan rakhne layak sampatti nahi hoti tatha bank unhe karz nahi dete, isliye yahi yojana unhe vitti vyavastha se jodkar unka karobar phir se khada karti hai. PMEGP badi pariyojna, MUDRA chhote karobar tatha Stand-Up India arkshit vargon ke udyami se juda hai, isliye talab wale ko karz PM SVANidhi hi deti hai. Exam point: PM SVANidhi yojana rehdi-patri walon ko bina gearan karz deti hai - yahi 10,000 se badhkar 50,000 tak pahunchta hai.

qe: The 'One Nation, One Ration Card' (ONORC) scheme falls under which ministry?
qh: 'वन नेशन, वन राशन कार्ड' (ONORC) योजना किस मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत आती है?
o: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
e: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) yojana Upbhokta Mamle, Khady tatha Sarvjanik Vitaran Mantralay ke adheen aati hai; iske zariye raashan card dhaarak desh mein kahin bhi apna anaaj le sakte hain. Yahi soch is yojana ke peechhe hai ki kaam ke liye doosre shahar gaye majdoor khane ke anaaj ke liye gaon wapas nahi aa sakta tha, isliye ek hi card ko poore desh mein chalu karne se unhe apna hissa kahin bhi mil jaata hai. Grih tatha anya mantralayon ka naam is yojana ke sahi bharosa nahi hai, isliye aise vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: ONORC yojana Khady tatha Sarvjanik Vitaran Mantralay ke adheen hai - isse raashan card kahin bhi kaam karta hai.

qe: What is the insurance cover for 'Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana' (PMSBY) for total disability?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षा बीमा योजना' (PMSBY) के तहत पूर्ण विकलांगता के लिए बीमा कवर क्या है?
e: PMSBY ke tehat purn viklangata (disability) hone par 2 lakh rupaye tatha mrityu par bhi 2 lakh rupaye ka beema milta hai; adhi viklangata par 1 lakh rupaye diye jaate hain. Iska sach yahi hai ki durghatna ke baad kaam karne ki kshamata chali jaane par pora jeevan kharch badh jaata hai, isliye yahi cover parivar ko sahara deta hai; ismein prem keval 20 rupaye salana hai.50,000 tatha 1 lakh ke aankde adhi viklangata jaisi anya surat ke hain, isliye purn viklangata par 2 lakh hi milte hain. Exam point: PMSBY ke tehat purn viklangata par 2 lakh rupaye milte hain - ismein mrityu par bhi utni hi rakam milti hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to rejuvenate and protect the Ganga river?
qh: गंगा नदी के संरक्षण और पुनरुद्धार के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Namami Gange yojana Ganga nadi ke sanrakshan tatha punaruddhar ke liye shuru ki gayi thi; iske tehat nadi mein girne wale keechad (sewage) ki safai, ghaton ka sudhar tatha saaf paani ke plant lagane ka kaam hota hai. Iska kaaran bhi yahi hota hai ki Ganga se lakhon logon ki peene ka paani tatha kheti judi hai, isliye nadi ki safai se swasthya tatha ban ke jeev bhi bachte hain. Green India Mission jungle se, Jal Shakti Abhiyan paani bachane se tatha Swachh Bharat safai se juda hai, isliye Ganga ke punaruddhar wali yojana Namami Gange hi hai. Exam point: Ganga nadi ki safai tatha punaruddhar ke liye Namami Gange yojana chalti hai - ismein nadi ka keechad tatha ghat sudhare jaate hain.

qe: The 'PM-SYM' scheme is meant for the pension of which category of people?
qh: 'PM-SYM' योजना किस श्रेणी के लोगों की पेंशन के लिए है?
e: PM-SYM yojana asangathit kshetra ke shramikon ko badhape mein 3,000 rupaye mahine ki pension dene ke liye hai; ismein 18 se 40 varsh ke aise shramik shamil ho sakte hain jinki aay 15,000 rupaye mahine tak ho; sath varsh ki umar par pension shuru hoti hai. Yahi wajah ise zaroori banati hai ki majdoor varg ke paas PF tatha gratuity jaisi suvidha nahi hoti, isliye chhote-chhote yogdan se unke budhape ka kharch tay ho jaata hai. Vaigyanik, kisan tatha sarkari karmachari ke liye alag vyavastha hoti hai, isliye asangathit shramik hi is yojana ka labharthi hai. Exam point: PM-SYM asangathit kshetra ke shramikon ki pension yojana hai - ismein 60 varsh ke baad 3,000 rupaye mahine milte hain.

qe: What is the main goal of 'Mission Sagarmala'?
qh: 'सागरमाला मिशन' (Mission Sagarmala) का मुख्य लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Providing drinking water to coastal areas
e: Sagarmala mission ka mukhya lakhya bandargah ke aadhaar par vikas (port-led development) tatha unka adhunikikaran hai; ismein bandargahon ki gehrai badhana, road-rail se jodna tatha tatiy kshetra mein udyog lagana shamil hai. Iske peechhe yahi baat hai ki desh ka bahari vyapar bahut bada hissa bandargahon se hota hai tatha unke raste aane-jaane ka kharch ghatane se niryat sasta padta hai, isliye yahi mission tatiy kshetra mein rozgar badhata hai. Tatiy kshetra mein peene ka paani, samundri ship badhana ya gehre samudra ki khanan iske sahi vishay nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Sagarmala mission bandargah ke aadhaar par vikas tatha unke adhunikikaran ka mission hai - yahi niryat sasta karta hai.

qe: Under the 'Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana', what is the maximum entry age for a girl child?
qh: 'सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना' के तहत कन्या के लिए अधिकतम प्रवेश आयु क्या है?
e: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana ke tehat das varsh tak ki kanya ka khata khola ja sakta hai; ismein thodi-thodi rakam jama karke uski padhai tatha vivah ke liye bachat tayar ki jaati hai tatha ismein achha byaj tatha kar laabh milta hai. Iska pakka kaaran yahi hai ki beti ke liye bachat karna parivar tatha samaj dono ke liye suraksha deta hai, isliye yahi yojana beti bachao beti padhao ke saath milkar kaam karti hai. 12 ya 18 varsh wale vikalp is khate khole jaane ki sahi aayu nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana mein das varsh tak ki kanya ka khata khola ja sakta hai - yahi uski padhai tatha vivah ke liye bachat banati hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide broadband access to public places via Wi-Fi?
qh: सार्वजनिक स्थानों पर वाई-फाई के माध्यम से ब्रॉडबैंड पहुंच प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: PM-WANI yojana ka maksad sarvjanik sthalon par wifi ke zariye internet pahunchana hai; ismein chhote dukandar, CSC wale tatha anya log Public Data Office ke roop mein registration karke wifi bech sakte hain. Yahi tark sabse upar hai ki har jagah mobile data mehanga padta hai, isliye sasti internet ki suvidha dene se padhai tatha chhote karobar dono ko bal milta hai; ismein koi licence shulk nahi lagta. Gram Net ya Digital India ke naam anya kaam ke hain, isliye public wifi wali yojana ka naam PM-WANI hi hai. Exam point: sarvjanik sthalon par wifi dene wali yojana PM-WANI hai - ismein chhote dukandar wifi bech sakte hain.

qe: The 'E-Shram' portal was launched to create a database for which group?
qh: 'ई-श्रम' (E-Shram) पोर्टल किस समूह के लिए डेटाबेस बनाने हेतु लॉन्च किया गया था?
e: E-Shram portal asangathit shramikon ka data base banane ke liye launch kiya gaya tha; ismein nirm karmi, homestay majdoor, safai karmi tatha anya aise shramik apna panjikaran kar apna UAN number paate hain. Isme yahi vichaar kaam karta hai ki aise shramikon ka koi sarkari record nahi hota, isliye panjikaran hone par aapatkalin sahayata, beema tatha yojanaon ka laabh seedha unhe mil jaata hai. Sarkari karmachari, bihar ke kisan ya vishwavidyalaya ke chhatra is portal ke sahi labharthi nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: E-Shram portal asangathit shramikon ka data base banane ke liye hai - isse unhe yojanaon ka laabh milta hai.

qe: What is the financial aid provided for toilet construction under 'Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen)'?
qh: 'स्वच्छ भारत मिशन (ग्रामीण)' के तहत शौचालय निर्माण के लिए कितनी वित्तीय सहायता दी जाती है?
e: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) ke tehat ghar mein shauchalaya banane wale labharthi ko 12,000 rupaye ki vitti sahayata di jaati hai; ismein rakam DBT se sidha khate mein jaati hai. Iska asar yahi hai ki khule mein shauch jaane se paani tatha khana kharab hota hai tatha bachche beemar padte hain, isliye shauchalaya banane se swasthya tatha samman dono badhta hai; iska nara 'Ek Kadam Swachhata Ki Aur' hai.5,000 tatha 15,000 ke aankde anya sahayata ke hain, isliye shauchalaya banane par 12,000 rupaye hi milte hain. Exam point: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) mein shauchalaya banane par 12,000 rupaye ki sahayata milti hai - yahi khule shauchan se hone wali bimaari rokta hai.

qe: The 'Ujala' scheme is managed by which agency?
qh: 'उजाला' (UJALA) योजना का प्रबंधन किस एजेंसी द्वारा किया जाता है?
e: UJALA yojana ka prabandhan EESL (Energy Efficiency Services Limited) karta hai; yahi sanstha sasti LED bulb, tubelight tatha fan baantne ka kaam dekhti hai. Isme yahi soch chhupi hai ki ek bade paimane par kharid kar sasti keemat par bulb dena tatha purane bulb wapas lena aise vishesh nikay ka kaam hai, isliye yahi company rajyaon ke saath milkar is yojana ko poore desh mein chalaati hai. PFC, NHPC ya NTPC ke vikalp is yojana ke sahi prabandhak nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: UJALA yojana ka prabandhan EESL karta hai - yahi saste LED bulb tatha tubelight baantta hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide solar-powered lamps to students in rural areas?
qh: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों के छात्रों को सौर ऊर्जा से चलने वाले लैंप प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Solar Study Lamp Scheme ke tehat gaon ke chhatron ko saur urja se chalne wala lamp diya jaata hai, taaki bijli na hone par bhi wo raat mein padh sakein; ise IIT Bombay tatha Ministry of New and Renewable Energy ne milkar shuru kiya tha. Iska kaaran bhi yahi hota hai ki padhai ki roshni ke bina bachche peeche reh jaate hain, isliye yahi yojana unhe saur lamp dekar padhai tatha bijli ki bachat dono ka laabh deti hai. KUSUM kisaanon ke saur pump, UJALA LED bulb tatha SAUBHAGYA ghar ki bijli se juda hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: grameen chhatron ko saur lamp dene wali yojana Solar Study Lamp Scheme hai - yahi bijli na hone par padhai ko sahara deti hai.

qe: Under 'Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana' (PMGSY), what is the population threshold for a village in plain areas to be connected?
qh: PMGSY के तहत मैदानी क्षेत्रों में जुड़ने वाले गाँव के लिए जनसंख्या सीमा क्या है?
e: PMGSY ke tehat maidan wale kshetra mein kam se kam 500 logon ki aabadi wala gaon tatha pahadi ya van-kshetra mein 250 logon wala gaon pukki sadak se judta hai; ise 2000 mein aarambh hua tha. Iska asli kaaran yahi nikalta hai ki sadak na hone se kisaanon ka maal bazaar tak nahi pahunchta tha tatha beemar ko aspatal le jaana mushkil hota tha, isliye yahi yojana gaon ko vikas ki mukhya dhara se jodti hai.1000 tatha 2000 ki aabadi ki seema pahadi ya van kshetra ke liye bhi nahi hai; maidan ke liye 500 hi sahi aankda hai. Exam point: PMGSY mein maidan wale kshetra ke liye 500 logon ki aabadi ki seema hai - yahi gaon ko pukki sadak se jodti hai.

qe: What is the tagline of 'Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana'?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना' का नारा (tagline) क्या है?
e: PM Jan Dhan Yojana ka nara ya tagline 'Mera Khata, Bhagya Vidhata' hai; isse jude khate khole jaane ke saath unmein RuPay card tatha durghatna beema jaisi suvidha bhi judti hai. Iske pichhe yahi soch hai ki khate se jude hone par insaan ki bachat surakshit hoti hai tatha sarkari sahayata usse seedha milti hai, isliye yahi nara khate ko kismat badalne ka zariya batata hai. Har Ghar Jal, Sabka Saath Sabka Vikas tatha Beti Bachao Beti Padhao anya yojanaon ke nare hain, isliye 'Mera Khata, Bhagya Vidhata' hi is yojana ka nara hai. Exam point: PM Jan Dhan Yojana ka nara ya tagline 'Mera Khata, Bhagya Vidhata' hai - yahi khate ko kismat badalne ka zariya batata hai.

qe: Which scheme provides short-term credit to farmers for crops and other needs?
qh: किस योजना के तहत किसानों को फसलों और अन्य जरूरतों के लिए अल्पकालिक ऋण प्रदान किया जाता है?
e: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) yojana ke tehat kisaanon ko beej, khaad tatha anya zaruraton ke liye alpkalik (short term) karz milta hai, jise fasal katne ke baad chukaya jaata hai; ismein byaj par riyayat bhi milti hai. Yahi baat ise khaas banati hai ki fasal bote samay kharcha ek saath aata hai, isliye sarkari byaj dar par karz milne se kisaan sahukaron ke bhari byaj se bach jaata hai. PM-KISAN sahayata, e-NAM bazaar tatha PM-KMY pension anya yojanaon se juda hai, isliye alpkalik karz dene wala KCC hi sahi hai. Exam point: KCC ke tehat kisaanon ko alpkalik karz milta hai - yahi fasal tatha anya zaruraton ke liye diya jaata hai.

qe: The 'e-NAM' portal is related to which of the following?
qh: 'e-NAM' पोर्टल निम्नलिखित में से किससे संबंधित है?
o: National Agriculture Market for online trading
e: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market) ek online portal hai jahan desh ki mandiyon ko jod kar kisan apni fasal door baithe vyapari ko bina beech wale bech sakta hai; ise 2016 mein aarambh hua. Iska mool kaaran yahi hai ki pehle mandi ke bichole hi keemat tay karte the, isliye online nilami tatha paari (bhaav) lene se kisaan ko achha daam tatha jaldi bhugtan milta hai. Daigital pehchaan, urja lekha tatha daigital shiksha anya kaam hain, isliye kheti ke maal ki online bikri hi e-NAM ka vishay hai. Exam point: e-NAM portal online kheti bazaar se juda hai - ismein kisan apni fasal desh mein kahin bhi bech sakta hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to ensure the safety and dignity of sanitation workers?
qh: स्वच्छता कार्यकर्ताओं की सुरक्षा और सम्मान सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: NAMASTE yojana safai karmiyon ki suraksha tatha samman sunishchit karne ke liye shuru ki gayi; iska poora naam National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem hai tatha yahi unhe machine tatha surakshit tarike se saaf-safai karne mein madad karti hai. Isme yahi baat dhyan dene layak hai ki hatte tatha seekar (sewer) mein utarkar safai karna jaanleva hota hai, isliye yahi yojana aise karmiyon ko surakshit taknik tatha behtar kaam dilati hai. AMRUT shehri suvidha, HRIDAY dharohar tatha safai abhiyan se juda hai, isliye safai karmiyon ki suraksha ka kaam NAMASTE ka hai. Exam point: NAMASTE yojana safai karmiyon ki suraksha tatha samman ke liye hai - yahi unhe surakshit tatha machine wale kaam se jodti hai.

qe: What is the maximum limit of an annual premium to be eligible for 'PM-KMY' pension?
qh: 'PM-KMY' पेंशन के लिए पात्र होने हेतु अधिकतम वार्षिक प्रीमियम सीमा क्या है? (Note: Context is age dependent)
e: PM-KMY pension ke liye patrata rakhne wale kisan ka yogdan 55 se 200 rupaye mahine ke beech hota hai tatha yahi rakam umar ke hisaab se tay hoti hai; ismein sarkar bhi barabar rakam daalti hai tatha Note: yojana ke sandarbh (context) mein yahi aankde sahi hain. Iska seedha kaaran yahi hai ki thodi-thodi rakam jama karne se badhape par 3,000 rupaye mahine ki pension ka intezaam ho jaata hai, isliye chhote kisaan ke liye ye ek sahayak vyavastha hai.100 tatha 436 rupaye anya yojanaon ke prem hain, isliye 55 se 200 rupaye ka daayra hi is yojana ka yogdan hai. Exam point: PM-KMY mein yogdan 55 se 200 rupaye mahine ke beech hota hai - ismein sarkar bhi barabar rakam daalti hai tatha Note: yojana ke sandarbh (context) mein yahi aankde sahi hain.

qe: The 'PRASAD' scheme is focused on which sector?
qh: 'प्रसाद' (PRASAD) योजना किस क्षेत्र पर केंद्रित है?
e: PRASAD yojana (Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Augmentation Drive) tirth sthalon ke sudhar tatha tirth yatra ko badhava dene par kendra hai; iske tehat tirth sthalon mein saaf-safai, pahunch tatha yatri suvidhaen sudhari jaati hain. Yahi wajah hai jis se ki tirth sthalon par aane wale yatri tatha unse judi aay ko badhava dene se wahan ke logon ka rozgar bhi badhta hai; ise paryatan mantralay chalaata hai. Khady vitaran, khel ko badhava tatha saur urja anya vishay hain, isliye tirth sthalon ka sudhar hi PRASAD ka kaam hai. Exam point: PRASAD yojana tirth sthalon ke sudhar tatha aadhyatmik yatra ko badhava dene se judi hai - yahi yatri suvidhaen sudharti hai.

qe: Which scheme aims to provide health cards to farmers containing nutrient status of their soil?
qh: किस योजना का लक्ष्य किसानों को उनके खेत की मिट्टी की पोषक स्थिति वाले स्वास्थ्य कार्ड प्रदान करना है?
e: Soil Health Card Scheme ke tehat kisaanon ko unke khet ki mitti ki jaanch ke baad ek card diya jaata hai, jismein mitti mein kaun sa poshak tatva kam tatha kaun sa zyada hai, yahi likha hota hai. Iska kaaran bhi yahi hota hai ki bina jaanch khaad daalne se mitti kharab tatha kharch bekaar jaata hai, isliye yahi card kisaan ko sahi khaad tatha sahi matara chunne mein madad karta hai. KCC, PM-KISAN ya Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana ke vikalp is kaam se alag hain, isliye wo sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Soil Health Card Scheme kisaanon ko mitti ki poshak sthiti wala card deti hai - yahi sahi khaad chunne mein madad karta hai.

qe: The 'Gobar-Dhan' scheme is a part of which larger mission?
qh: 'गोबर-धन' (Gobar-Dhan) योजना किस बड़े मिशन का हिस्सा है?
e: Gobar-Dhan yojana Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase-II ka hissa hai; iske tehat gaon ke pashuon ka gobar ikattha karke gobar gas tatha khaad banane wale plant lagaye jaate hain. Isme yahi baat chhupi hai ki isse gaon mein safai badhti hai, tel-gas ki bachat hoti hai tatha kisaanon ko organic khaad milta hai; plant se nikli gas rozmarra ke kaam aati hai. PM-KUSUM saur pump, Namami Gange nadi tatha Jal Jeevan Mission paani se juda hai, isliye gobar se gas banane wala kaam Gobar-Dhan ka hai. Exam point: Gobar-Dhan yojana Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase-II ka hissa hai - yahi gobar se gas tatha khaad banati hai.

qe: Under 'Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana' (PMFBY), what is the premium for Kharif crops?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना' (PMFBY) के तहत खरीफ फसलों के लिए प्रीमियम क्या है?
e: PMFBY ke tehat kharif faslon par kisaan ka prem keval 2.0 pratishat hota hai, jabki rabi faslon par 1.5 pratishat tatha vyaparik (commercial) faslon par 5 pratishat; shesh kharch sarkar uthaati hai. Iska mukhya aadhaar yahi hai ki kam prem hone se chhote kisaan bhi beema le paate hain tatha kharab mausam, keet tatha bimari se hone wale nuksan ki bharpai ho jaati hai.10 tatha 5 pratishat ke aankde anya faslon ke hain, isliye kharif ke liye 2 pratishat hi sahi prem hai. Exam point: PMFBY mein kharif faslon ke liye prem 2.0 pratishat hai - ismein shesh kharch sarkar uthaati hai.

qe: What is the purpose of the 'NIPUN Bharat' mission?
qh: 'निपुण भारत' (NIPUN Bharat) मिशन का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Foundational literacy and numeracy for children
e: NIPUN Bharat mission ka uddeshya bachon ki bunyadi padhai tatha ginti (foundational literacy and numeracy) majboot karna hai; yahi mission class 3 tak ke bachon ko padhne, likhne tatha ginti karne yogya banane par kaam karta hai. Iske liye yahi soch rakhi gayi ki shuruaati saalon mein padhai kamzor reh jaane par aage ki padhai nahi jamti, isliye yahi mission khel tatha aakarshak tarike se padhai majboot karta hai. Buzurgon ki daigital saksharta, snaatakon ka kaushal prashikshan ya koi anya kaam is mission ka sahi uddeshya nahi hai, isliye aise vikalp galat hain. Exam point: NIPUN Bharat mission bunyadi padhai tatha ginti majboot karne ke liye hai - yahi class 3 tak ke bachon par dhyan deta hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide high-quality generic medicines at affordable prices?
qh: सस्ती कीमतों पर उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली जेनेरिक दवाएं प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: PM Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana ke tehat sasti keemat par achhi gunvatta wali jeneik (generic) dawaein Janaushadhi kendron se milti hain; in dawaon ka daam bazaar ki brand wali dawaon se kaafi kam hota hai. Iske liye ek zaroori baat yahi hai ki ilaj ka kharch kam hone se aam aadmi ka bacha paisa tatha garibi par bojh dono ghat te hain; ismein kendr kholne wale ko sahayata bhi milti hai. Janani Suraksha Yojana prasav sahayata, Mission Indradhanush teekakaran tatha Ayushman Bharat aspatal kharch se juda hai, isliye sasti jeneik dawa wali yojana PMBJP hi hai. Exam point: sasti jeneik dawaein PM Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana se milti hain - yahi ilaj ka kharch kam karti hai.

qe: What is the primary aim of the 'PM-DevINE' scheme?
qh: 'PM-DevINE' योजना का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: PM-DevINE yojana ka mukhya uddeshya North-Eastern kshetra ka vikas hai; iske tehat wahan ki khaas zaruraton ke liye sahayata wali pariyojnaen (jaise social infrastructure tatha aajeevika) chalti hain. Iska sabse bada kaaran yahi hai ki is kshetra ko doori tatha patla buniyaad dhanche jaisi samasyaon se guzarna padta hai, isliye vishesh sahayata dene se rajya ki aay tatha suvidhaen badhti hain. Shehron mein peene ka paani, raksha nirman tatha daigital shiksha anya yojanaon ke vishay hain, isliye North-East ke vikas ka kaam PM-DevINE karta hai. Exam point: PM-DevINE yojana North-Eastern kshetra ke vikas ke liye hai - yahi wahan ki khaas zaruraton par kharch hoti hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide high-speed internet to all villages via 'Optical Fibre'?
qh: 'ऑप्टिकल फाइबर' के माध्यम से सभी गांवों को हाई-स्पीड इंटरनेट प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Optical fibre ke zariye sabhi gaon ko high speed internet dene wali yojana BharatNet hai; iska nibandhan gram panchayat tak fibre pahunchana tatha usmein se wifi tatha broadband dena hai. Iska mool aadhaar yahi hai ki internet aane par gaon ke bachche online padhai kar sakte hain tatha sarkari sevaen bhi aasaani se milti hain, isliye yahi mission sheher tatha gaon ke beech ka faasla kam karta hai. Chhote dukandar ka wifi, poora Digital India programme tatha samundri sahyog anya vishay hain, isliye gaon tak fibre pahunchane wala kaam BharatNet ka hai. Exam point: gaon tak optical fibre se internet pahunchane wali yojana BharatNet hai - yahi daigital antar ghatati hai.

qe: Under the 'PM-SHRI' scheme, what does 'SHRI' stand for?
qh: 'PM-SHRI' योजना में 'SHRI' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: PM-SHRI yojana mein SHRI ka matlab Schools for Rising India hai; iske tehat desh Bharat ke chuni hui schools ko adarsh schoolon ke roop mein vikasit kiya jaata hai. Iska praathamik kaaran yahi hai ki achhi padhai, khel, tatha haath ka kaam wale school bachon tatha unke parivar ko aakarshit karte hain, isliye yahi model school khade karne se poore kshetra ki shiksha sudhrti hai. Solar High-speed Rural Infrastructure tatha Social Health Reform Initiative ke vistaar is naam ke akshar nahi hain, isliye Schools for Rising India hi sahi hai. Exam point: PM-SHRI mein SHRI ka arth Schools for Rising India hai - yahi chuni hui schools ko adarsh school banati hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide a monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 to shopkeepers and retail traders?
qh: दुकानदारों और खुदरा व्यापारियों को 3,000 रुपये की मासिक पेंशन प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Dukandaron tatha chhote vyapariyon ko badhape ke liye 3,000 rupaye mahine ki pension dene wali yojana PM Laghu Vyapari Maandhan Yojana hai; ismein aise dukandar tatha chhote vyapari shamil hote hain jinki kamai seemit ho; sath varsh ke baad har mahine pension milti hai. Iska kaaran bhi yahi hota hai ki dukandaron ke liye alag se koi pension vyavastha nahi thi, isliye unke chhote yogdan par sarkar se barabar rakam jod kar yahi suraksha banayi gayi. PM-KISAN sahayata, Atal Pension Yojana tatha PM-SYM anya vargon ke liye hain, isliye dukandaron ke liye PM Laghu Vyapari Maandhan Yojana hi hai. Exam point: dukandaron tatha chhote vyapariyon ko 3,000 rupaye mahine ki pension PM Laghu Vyapari Maandhan Yojana deti hai - yahi unke badhape ki suraksha hai.

qe: What is the maximum subsidy provided under the 'PMEGP' for a manufacturing project?
qh: विनिर्माण परियोजना के लिए 'PMEGP' के तहत दी जाने वाली अधिकतम सब्सिडी क्या है?
e: PMEGP ke tehat banaye jaane wale vinnirman pariyojna par shehri kshetra mein 25 pratishat tatha grameen kshetra mein 35 pratishat tak ki adhiktam subsidy milti hai; vishisht vargon (SC/ST, mahila tatha ex-serviceman) ke liye yahi seema aur badh jaati hai. Iska asli tark yahi hai ki naye udyami ko machine tatha building par bada kharch karna padta hai, isliye subsidy milne se lagat kam hoti hai tatha naye udyog tatha rozgar badhte hain.50 tatha 15 pratishat ke aankde kisi anya shreni ke hain; PMEGP mein adhiktam 35 pratishat tak hi subsidy milti hai. Exam point: PMEGP mein adhiktam subsidy 35 pratishat tak milti hai - yahi naye udyog tatha rozgar ko badhava deti hai.

qe: The 'Vibrant Villages Programme' is launched for the development of villages in which area?
qh: 'वाइब्रेंट विलेज प्रोग्राम' किस क्षेत्र के गांवों के विकास के लिए शुरू किया गया है?
e: Vibrant Villages Programme ka dhyan uttari seema se lage gaon ke vikas par hai; iske tehat aise gaon mein sadak, bijli, internet tatha aajeevika ke kaam hote hain, taaki wahan ke log wahin rehna chahein. Yahi soch iske pichhe hai ki seemavarti gaon khali hote jaane se seema ki nigrani tatha suraksha kamzor hoti hai, isliye unhe suvidhaon se jodna raashtriya hith mein hai. Madhya bharat ke aadivasi kshetra, tatiy kshetra ya registan wale vikalp is karyakram ke sahi kshetra nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: Vibrant Villages Programme uttari seemavarti gaon ke vikas ke liye hai - isse log wahin rehkar seema ki suraksha mein sahayak hote hain.

qe: Which scheme aims to empower women through self-help groups (SHGs) by making them 'Lakhpati Didis'?
qh: स्वयं सहायता समूहों (SHGs) के माध्यम से महिलाओं को 'लखपति दीदी' बनाकर सशक्त बनाने का लक्ष्य किस योजना का है?
e: Svayn sahayata samuhon (SHGs) ke zariye mahilaon ko lakhpati didi banane ka lakshya NRLM (Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission) rakhta hai; iske tehat gaon ki mahilaen samuh banakar karz tatha prashikshan se apna kaam khadi karti hain. Isme yahi tark lagta hai ki mahilaen samuh mein jude hone par bank unhe bharosa karta hai tatha woh apni aay badhakar saalana lakhon ki kamai ke kareeb pahunch sakti hain. Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, Stand-Up India ya Matru Vandana Yojana ke vikalp is lakshya se alag hain, isliye wo sahi nahi hain. Exam point: mahilaon ko lakhpati didi banane ka lakshya NRLM rakhta hai - yahi SHGs ke zariye unhe karz tatha prashikshan deta hai.

qe: The 'PM-PRANAM' scheme is related to which of the following?
qh: 'PM-PRANAM' योजना निम्नलिखित में से किससे संबंधित है?
o: Alternative fertilizers and balanced use of chemical fertilizers
e: PM-PRANAM yojana ka sambandh vikalpik (alternative) khaad tatha rasayanik khaad ke santulit upyog se hai; iska poora roop Pradhan Mantri Promotion of Alternate Nutrients for Agriculture Management Yojana hai. Iska mukhya tark yahi hai ki urea tatha anya rasayanik khaad ke adhik upyog se mitti kharab hoti hai tatha sarkari subsidy par bada bojh padta hai, isliye yahi yojana rajyaon ko prabandhan se jode rakhti hai. Buzurgon ki pension, Sanskrit bhasha tatha tirth sthalon ki safai anya vishay hain, isliye khaad ke santulit upyog wala kaam PM-PRANAM ka hai. Exam point: PM-PRANAM yojana vikalpik khaad tatha santulit khaad upyog se judi hai - yahi mitti tatha subsidy dono bachaati hai.

qe: What is the main objective of the 'MISHTI' scheme?
qh: 'मिष्टी' (MISHTI) योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: MISHTI yojana ka mukhya uddeshya tatiy kshetra mein mangrove (mangrove) ke jungle lagana tatha unki raksha karna hai; yahi Mission for Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Income hai. Iske andar yahi soch hai ki mangroves tufan tatha samundri lehron ki takat rok kar tatiy gaon tatha jameen bachaate hain tatha machhliyon tatha jeevon ka ghar bhi hote hain, isliye yahi yojana jalvayu parivartan se ladne mein madad karti hai. Matritva swasthya, grameen safai ya mithai ka utpadan is yojana se juda nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: MISHTI yojana tatiy kshetra mein mangrove lagane ki yojana hai - yahi tufan se tatiy gaon tatha jeev-jantu ko bachaati hai.

qe: Under the 'PM Vishwakarma' scheme, financial support is provided to which group?
qh: 'पीएम विश्वकर्मा' योजना के तहत किस समूह को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है?
e: PM Vishwakarma yojana ke tehat purane tatha paramparik karigaron (lohar, kalaai, raaj, mitti ke kaam wale tatha anya) ko karz, prashikshan tatha behtar auzaar ki suvidhaen di jaati hain; ismein shuruaati karz sasti byaj par milta hai. Iska pahla kaaran yahi hai ki aise kaarigar ke paas naye yantra kharidne ka dhan nahi hota tatha unki hunar ko bazaar tatha pehchaan nahi milti, isliye yahi yojana unhe aatm-samman tatha aay deti hai. IT professional, professor tatha sports coach anya varg hain, isliye paramparik karigar tatha shilpkar hi is yojana ke labharthi hain. Exam point: PM Vishwakarma yojana paramparik karigaron tatha shilpkaaron ki sahayata ke liye hai - yahi unhe karz tatha prashikshan deti hai.

qe: Which portal was launched to ensure credit to MSMEs within 59 minutes?
qh: 59 मिनट के भीतर MSMEs को ऋण सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कौन सा पोर्टल लॉन्च किया गया था?
e: MSMEs ko 59 minute ke andar karz sunishchit karne ke liye psbloansin59minutes.com portal launch kiya gaya tha; ismein chhote karobar apni GST tatha bank ke aankde de kar turant aage ki manzoori paate hain. Iska ek aur kaaran yahi hai ki pehle karz ki prakriya mahino tak chalti thi tatha chhote udyami ko turant manzoori ya inkaar ka bharosa nahi hota tha, isliye yahi portal samay bachaata hai; iske baad asli karz bank tay karta hai. Udyami Portal, MSME SAMADHAAN ya CHAMPIONS ke vikalp is portal ke sahi naam nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: 59 minute mein karz sunishchit karne wala portal psbloansin59minutes.com hai - yahi chhote karobari ki rukawat hatata hai.

qe: The 'PM-JAY' (Ayushman Bharat) provides cover for which type of hospitalization?
qh: 'PM-JAY' (आयुष्मान भारत) किस प्रकार के अस्पताल में भर्ती होने के लिए कवर प्रदान करता है?
e: PM-JAY (Ayushman Bharat) ke tehat dvitiyak (secondary) tatha tritiyak (tertiary) star ke aspatal mein bharti hone ka kharch cover hota hai; yani bade operation tatha vishisht ilaj wale kaam ismein aate hain. Iska kaaran bhi yahi hota hai ki bade ilaj ka kharch hi parivar ko kangaal karta hai, isliye yahi cover aspatal mein bharti, jaanch tatha operation par kharch uthaata hai; bahar ke OPD ilaj ka sahayak rasta alag se chalta hai. Keval pehla ilaj tatha OPD is yojana mein nahi aate, isliye aspatal mein bharti wala dvitiyak tatha tritiyak ilaj hi cover hota hai. Exam point: PM-JAY dvitiyak tatha tritiyak star ke aspatal ke ilaj par cover deta hai - yahi bade ilaj ka kharch uthaata hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched for the integrated development of theme-based tourist circuits?
qh: थीम-आधारित पर्यटन सर्किटों के एकीकृत विकास के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: Swadesh Darshan yojana theem (theme) ke aadhaar par banaye gaye paryatan chakron ka ek saath vikas karti hai; jaise aadhyatmik, hriday, dharohar tatha paryavaran jaisi theme tay ki gayi hain. Yah zaroori tha kyunki ek hi kshetra ke kai sthal ek doosre se jude hone par paryatak lamba rukta hai tatha wahan ke logon ko rozgar milta hai, isliye yahi yojana rajya sarkaron ke saath milkar sthalon ki pahunch, suvidha tatha prachar par kharch karti hai. PRASAD keval tirth sthalon par, HRIDAY dharohar shahron par tatha Dekho Apna Desh deshvasiyon ko ghoomne ke liye prerit karne par kaam karta hai, isliye wo teeno alag hain. Exam point: theme aadhaar par paryatan chakron ke ekikrit vikas ki yojana Swadesh Darshan hai - yahi PRASAD ka purak hai.

qe: What is the 'PM-GKAY' (Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana)?
qh: 'PM-GKAY' (गरीब कल्याण अन्न योजना) क्या है?
o: Scheme providing 5kg free food grains per person to NFSA beneficiaries
e: PM-GKAY ka matlab Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana hai tatha iske tehat rashtriya khady suraksha adhiniyam ke labharthiyon ko prati vyakti prati mahine 5 kilogram anaaj muft diya jaata hai; ise 2020 ke COVID daur mein shuru kiya gaya tha tatha baad mein ise badhaya gaya. Yah madad isliye di gayi ki mahamari ke samay kaam band hone se garib parivar ke haath khali ho gaye the, isliye muft anaaj dene se koi bhookha nahi sota; ismein kharch poora kendra uthati hai. Rozgar dene wali, ghar dene wali ya padhai se judi yojana PM-GKAY nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: PM-GKAY NFSA labharthiyon ko prati vyakti 5 kilogram muft anaaj deti hai - yahi mahamari ke daur ki muft anaaj yojana hai.

qe: The 'Atal Bhujal Yojana' is a scheme focused on which issue?
qh: 'अटल भूजल योजना' किस मुद्दे पर केंद्रित एक योजना है?
e: Atal Bhujal Yojana dharti ke neeche jale bhandar (groundwater) ke prabandhan tatha sanrakshan par dhyan deti hai; ismein gaon star par bhujal arai (Water Security Plan) banakar pani ka hisaab liya jaata hai. Yah plan zaroori tha kyunki kai kshetron mein dharti ka pani bahut tezi se niche jaa raha tha tatha kheti tatha peene ka pani sankat mein aa gaya tha, isliye yahi yojana sarkar tantra tatha samaj ke sahyog se pani bachane ke kaam karti hai. Shehron mein varshajal sanchay, nadiyon ki safai ya badh niyantran iske muKhy vishay nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: Atal Bhujal Yojana bhujal ke prabandhan tatha sanrakshan ki yojana hai - yahi gaon star par pani ki suraksha ka plan banati hai.

qe: Which mission aims to eliminate 'Sickle Cell Anemia' in India by 2047?
qh: किस मिशन का लक्ष्य 2047 तक भारत में 'सिकल सेल एनीमिया' को खत्म करना है?
o: National Sickle Cell Anemia Elimination Mission
e: Rashtriya Sickle Cell Anemia Unmulan Mission ka lakshya 2047 tak desh se sickle cell anaemia ko jadat se khatam karna hai; ismein saath karod logon ki jaanch tatha jude logon ke ilaj ka pariyojan hai. Yah mission isliye bana ki yah rog khaas kar aadiwasi kshetron mein pita se santan mein chala jaata hai tatha isse sar dard, kamjori tatha shareer ke aankda badalne jaisi pareshani hoti hai; kendra ne yahi karyakram Budget 2023 mein ghoshit kiya tha. POSHAN Abhiyaan kuposhan par, Ayushman Bharat ilaj ke kharch par tatha Mission Indradhanush teekakaran par kaam karta hai, isliye wo teeno alag hain. Exam point: sickle cell anaemia ko 2047 tak khatam karne ka lakshya National Sickle Cell Anemia Elimination Mission ka hai - yahi aadiwasi kshetra mein jaanch tatha ilaj karata hai.

qe: What is the target year for the 'Net Zero' emission goal set by India?
qh: भारत द्वारा निर्धारित 'नेट जीरो' उत्सर्जन लक्ष्य का वर्ष क्या है?
e: Bharat ka net zero utsrajan lakshya 2070 ka hai; yani hum 2070 tak jitni greenhouse gas chhodenge uske barabar carbon soak karne ka intezaam karenge. Yah yah lakshya isliye tay kiya gaya ki bharat vikas ke liye abhi jalashay tatha udyog par nirbhar hai tatha ek saath vrind mein 2070 ke pahle poora band nahi kar sakta; isliye yahi varsh COP26 (Glasgow) mein ghoshit hua. 2050, 2030 ya 2100 wale vikalp bharat ke sahi lakshya varsh nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: bharat ka net zero utsrajan lakshya 2070 hai - yahi Glasgow sammelan mein ghoshit kiya gaya.

qe: The 'PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi' is a 100% centrally funded scheme. True or False?
qh: 'पीएम-किसान सम्मान निधि' 100% केंद्र द्वारा वित्त पोषित योजना है। सत्य या असत्य?
e: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi poori tarah kendra sarkar dwara vit poshit (100% centrally funded) yojana hai; ismein rajya sarkaron ka koi hissa nahi hota tatha rakam seedha kisaan ke bank khate mein aati hai. Yah vyavastha isliye rakhi gayi ki poore desh ke kisaanon ko ek hi niyam tatha ek hi samay par laabh mile tatha rajya ke hisse ke chakkar mein kisi kisaan ka bhugtan na ruke; kharch Bharat ki sanchit nidhi se hota hai. Isliye yah kathan sahi hai ki yahi yojana 100% kendra poshit hai tatha ismein rajya ka ansh nahi hai. Exam point: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi 100% kendra dwara poshit yojana hai - yahi saare desh ke patra kisaanon ko ek jaise laabh deti hai.

qe: Which organization manages the 'Atal Pension Yojana'?
qh: 'अटल पेंशन योजना' का प्रबंधन कौन सा संगठन करता है?
e: Atal Pension Yojana ko PFRDA chalata hai; iska poora naam Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority hai tatha yahi sanstha NPS tatha pension fundon ki dekh-rekh karti hai. Yah vyavastha isliye banayi gayi ki asangathit kshetra ke karmachariyon ke paas pension ka koi aur sahara nahi hota, isliye sarkar unke chhote yogdan tatha apne barabar ansh se unhe budhape mein 1,000 se 5,000 rupaye mahine ki pension deti hai.Banks ke niyamak, share bazaar ke chowkidaar tatha beema kamni ke roop mein RBI, SEBI tatha LIC ka kaam alag hai, isliye inhe is yojana ka prabandhak nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: Atal Pension Yojana ka prabandhan PFRDA karta hai - yahi pension kshetra ka viniyamak hai.

qe: The 'JAL-DHOOT' app was launched by which ministry to monitor groundwater levels?
qh: भूजल स्तर की निगरानी के लिए किस मंत्रालय द्वारा 'जलदूत' (JAL-DHOOT) ऐप लॉन्च किया गया था?
e: JAL-DHOOT (Jaldoot) app ko Grameen Vikas Mantralaya ne launch kiya tha; iske zariye jal shakti vibhagon ke karmi gaon mein bhujal star tatha talabon ki asli sthiti ki jankari tatha aankde sarkar ke paas pahunchate hain. Yah jaanch isliye zaroori hai ki kagaz par banayi gayi yojana tatha dharti ke asli pani mein bada antar ho jaata hai, isliye yahi app bhujal ke bhandar ka sahi chitra deta hai tatha jal jeevan mission ki nigrani mein madad karta hai. Pridhvi vigyan, parivesh ya shehri vikas mantralaya ke vikalp is app ke sahi sanchalak nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: JAL-DHOOT app Grameen Vikas Mantralaya ne launch kiya - yahi bhujal star ki asli nigrani ka zariya hai.

qe: What is the maximum age to open a 'Sukanya Samriddhi' account for a girl child?
qh: एक बालिका के लिए 'सुकन्या समृद्धि' खाता खोलने की अधिकतम आयु क्या है?
e: Sukanya Samriddhi khata kholne ke liye kanya ki adhiktam aayu das varsh hai; isse bade bachche ka khata is yojana mein nahi khul sakta. Yah seema isliye rakhi gayi ki bachat zyada samay tak jama rahe tatha padhai tatha vivah ka poora kharch usi se nikale; khate par achha byaj tatha kar chhoot milti hai tatha ise maa, pita ya guardian chalate hain.Paanch, barah tatha atharah varsh ki aayu ke vikalp is khate ki shart se mel nahi khaate; das varsh hi sahi seema hai. Exam point: Sukanya Samriddhi khate par das varsh ki aayu ki shart hai - yahi ladki ke naam par surakshit bachat ka zariya hai.

qe: Which scheme aims to provide universal access to social security for the unorganized sector through a portal?
qh: किस योजना का उद्देश्य एक पोर्टल के माध्यम से असंगठित क्षेत्र के लिए सामाजिक सुरक्षा तक सार्वभौमिक पहुंच प्रदान करना है?
e: E-Shram portal asangathit kshetra ke shramikon ko ek jagah jodkar unhe samajik suraksha yojanaon ka laabh dene ke liye bana hai; ismein panjikaran karke shramik apna UAN paata hai tatha baad mein beema, pension tatha anya yojanaon ki jankari usi ke madhyam se pahunchti hai. Yah portal isliye zaroori tha ki aise karmiyon ka koi sarkari record nahi tha tatha aapatkalin sahayata unhe pahunchana mushkil hota tha, isliye yahi data base sarkari yojanaon ka daara banta hai. MGNREGA majdoori guarantee, PM-GKAY muft anaaj tatha PM-SYM pension se juda hai, isliye wo alag hain. Exam point: asangathit shramikon ki samajik suraksha ke liye e-SHRAM portal ka panjikaran zaroori hai - yahi unka UAN number deta hai.

qe: The 'FASTag' system for toll collection uses which technology?
qh: टोल संग्रह के लिए 'फास्टैग' (FASTag) प्रणाली किस तकनीक का उपयोग करती है?
e: Toll par lage padhne wale yantra se gaadi ke sheeshe wale tag ki jankari radio tarangon (RFID) ke zariye pahunchti hai tatha khate se toll ki rakam kat jaati hai. Yah vidhi isliye apnayi gayi ki plaza par gaadi rokna tatha nakad dene mein lambi kataar tatha samay barbaad hota tha, isliye yahi vyavastha toll ko tez tatha paardarshi banati hai.Bluetooth, NFC tatha QR code ke vikalp is pranali ki taknik se alag hain, isliye woh sahi nahi thehrte. Exam point: FASTag RFID taknik par chalti hai - yahi bina gaadi roke toll kataut kar deti hai.

qe: Under 'PM Matru Vandana Yojana', the cash incentive is paid in how many installments?
qh: 'पीएम मातृ वंदना योजना' के तहत नकद प्रोत्साहन कितनी किस्तों में दिया जाता है?
e: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana mein pehli tatha doosri santan (doosri beti hone par) par nakad protsahan teen kisthon mein milta hai; khana tatha suvidha ke aadhaar par rakam alag-alag charnon mein khate mein aati hai. Yah kisten isliye rakhi gayi ki maa tatha bachche ko poshan, teekakaran tatha jaanch ke liye samay par madad mile tatha majdoori ki hani ki bharpai ho jaaye; iska kharch kendra tatha rajya dono uthate hain.Ek, paanch tatha do kisthon ke vikalp is niyam se mel nahi khaate; teen kisthon hi sahi sankhya hai. Exam point: PM Matru Vandana Yojana ka nakad protsahan teen kisthon mein milta hai - yahi maa tatha naye bachche ki poshan madad hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to reduce the import of edible oils via palm oil cultivation?
qh: पाम ऑयल की खेती के माध्यम से खाद्य तेलों के आयात को कम करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
o: NMEO-OP (National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm)
e: NMEO-OP yani National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm ka lakshya palm tel ki kheti badhakar khane wale tel ke aayat ko kam karna hai; ismein kisaanon ko paudh, sinchai tatha lagat ka support diya jaata hai tatha northeast tatha Andaman mein ise badhava diya jaata hai. Yah mission isliye zaroori tha ki bharat apne tel ki bada hissa bahar se kharidta hai, isliye deshi paidavar badhane se videshi mudra tatha kisaan ki aay dono ka bhala hota hai. KUSUM saur urja, hari kranti anaaj tatha Operation Greens sabzi-fal ke daam se juda hai, isliye wo teeno alag hain. Exam point: palm tel ki kheti se tel ka aayat kam karne wala mission NMEO-OP hai - yahi khane wale tel mein atm-nirbharta ka lakshya rakhta hai.

qe: What is the primary objective of 'Mission Amrit Sarovar'?
qh: 'मिशन अमृत सरोवर' का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Rejuvenation of 75 water bodies in every district
e: Mission Amrit Sarovar ke tehat desh ke pratyek jile mein 75 amrit sarovar (talab) banaye ya punarjivit kiye gaye, jisse 2023 ke Amrit Mahotsav ke samay 50,000 se adhik talab tayar hue; yahi 'Amrit Sarovar' ki soch azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav se judi thi. Yah kaam isliye kiya gaya ki barsat ka pani sanchit ho tatha bhujal bhare, jisse kheti tatha jaanwar ke peene ka pani milta rahe; sthal par hi mitti tatha majdoori se talab bante hain. Peene ka pani dena, samundron ki safai ya naye bandh banan is mission ka asli uddeshya nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Mission Amrit Sarovar se har jile mein 75 talab banaye tatha punarjivit kiye gaye - yahi varshajal sanchay tatha bhujal badhata hai.

qe: The 'MAHILA SAMMAN SAVINGS CERTIFICATE' is a small savings scheme launched for?
qh: 'महिला सम्मान बचत प्रमाणपत्र' एक छोटी बचत योजना है जो किसके लिए शुरू की गई है?
o: Women and girls for a 2-year period
e: Mahila Samman Bachat Patra (Mahila Samman Savings Certificate) do saal ki avadhi wali chhoti bachat yojana hai jo mahilaon tatha ladkiyon ke liye shuru ki gayi; ismein do saal mein 7.5 pratishat byaj milta hai tatha 2 lakh rupaye tak jama ho sakte hain. Yah yojana isliye layi gayi ki mahilaon ke paas chhote samay ke liye surakshit tatha achhi byaj wali bachat ka koi rasta nahi tha, isliye ise post office tatha bank dono se khola ja sakta hai.Buzurg, keval grameen mahilaen tatha keval vidhwa ka varg is yojana mein nahi aata; yahan mahilaen tatha ladkiyan hi jodi jaati hain. Exam point: Mahila Samman Bachat Patra do saal ke liye mahilaon tatha ladkiyon ke liye hai - ismein 7.5 pratishat byaj milta hai.

qe: Under 'Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana' (PMGSY), who maintains the roads?
qh: 'प्रधानमंत्री ग्राम सड़क योजना' (PMGSY) के तहत सड़कों का रखरखाव कौन करता है?
e: PMGSY ke tehat bani sadakon ka rakharakhav rajya sarkaren panchayaton ke zariye karti hain; nirman ka kharch kendra tatha rajya ke hisse se hota hai par rakh-rakhav ka kaam sthaaniy nikay tatha karmiyon par hota hai. Yah bandobast isliye kiya gaya ki jo sadak gaon ke log rozana istemal karte hain, uski dekh-rekh bhi unhi ke haath mein rahe tatha kharab hone par jaldi dhayan diya jaaye; isse kendra par bhaar kam hota hai. RBI, keval kendra sarkar ya niji thekedar wale vikalp is vyavastha ke sahi zimmedar nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PMGSY sadakon ka rakharakhav rajya sarkaren panchayaton ke zariye karti hain - yahi sadak ko lambi avadhi tak chalu rakhta hai.

qe: What is the primary target group of the 'PM-PRANAM' scheme?
qh: 'PM-PRANAM' योजना का प्राथमिक लक्ष्य समूह क्या है?
e: PM-PRANAM ka dhyan kheti mein use hone wale doosre poshak tatvon tatha rasayanik khaadon ke santulan par hai; achha prabandhan karne wale rajyaon ko yahi yojana protsahan deti hai. Yah soch isliye aai ki urea tatha anya rasayanik khaad ka adhik prayog mitti tatha paani ko kharab karta hai tatha subsidy par bhaari bojh padta hai, isliye yahi karyakram khaad ke santulan ko badhava deta hai.Shehri udyami, school ke bachche tatha soilder is yojana se door ke varg hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: PM-PRANAM yojana kisaanon tatha rajya sarkaron ko vikalpik khaad ke santulit upyog ke liye prerit karti hai - yahi mitti tatha subsidy bachaati hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide high-speed '5G' connectivity testing for startups and industry?
qh: स्टार्टअप और उद्योग के लिए हाई-स्पीड '5G' कनेक्टिविटी परीक्षण प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: 5G Testbed yojana ke tehat desh ke sansthanon mein high-speed 5G taknik ka aisa net-work khada kiya gaya jahan startup tatha udyog apne utpad tatha sevaen bina bade kharch parakh tatha sudhar sakte hain; ise IIT Madras tatha anya saat sansthanon ne milkar banaya. Yah madad isliye di gayi ki 5G ka istemal kheti, chikitsa tatha karkhane tak pahunche, isliye chhote khiladi bhi bade net-work par kharch kiye bina naye anuprayog bana sakein.Digital India, PM-WANI tatha BharatNet ke kaam anya kshetron ke hain, isliye inhe 5G parikshan ka zariya nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: startup tatha udyog ko 5G parakhne ki suvidha 5G Testbed yojana deti hai - yahi naye anuprayog ka rasta kholti hai.

qe: The 'Lakhpati Didi' scheme targets how many women for skill training?
qh: 'लखपति दीदी' योजना कितने महिलाओं को कौशल प्रशिक्षण देने का लक्ष्य रखती है?
e: Lakhpati Didi ka lakshya teen karod mahilaon ko svayn sahayata samuh (SHG) ke zariye kaushal prashikshan tatha karz se itna sashakt banana hai ki wo apne parivar ke liye saalana ek lakh rupaye se adhik kamayein; ise 2023 mein ghoshit kiya gaya. Yah lakshya isliye rakha gaya ki samuh wali mahilaen sirf chhote kaam tak na ruk jayein, balki dairy, silai, murgi-palan tatha anya dhandaon se unki aay badhe; ismein mahilaon ko prashikshan tatha bazaar se jodne par jor diya jaata hai. Ek, do ya paanch karod wale aankde is lakshya ki sahi sankhya nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: Lakhpati Didi yojana ka lakshya teen karod mahilaon ko lakhpati banana hai - yahi SHG ke zariye unki aay badhati hai.

qe: Which portal provides a 'Single Window' clearance for various government scholarship schemes?
qh: विभिन्न सरकारी छात्रवृत्ति योजनाओं के लिए 'सिंगल विंडो' क्लीयरेंस कौन सा पोर्टल प्रदान करता है?
e: Vibhinn sarkari chhatravritti yojanaon ke liye ek hi jagah par aavedan tatha manzoori ki suvidha National Scholarship Portal (NSP) deta hai; yahi portal chhatra, sanstha tatha vibhagon ko ek manch par jodta hai. Yah portal isliye bana ki har yojana ke liye alag-alag daftar tatha kagaz ke chakkar mein gaon tatha chote shahar ke chhatra peeche reh jaate the, isliye yahan se aavedan karne par rakam surukshit tatha samay par chhatra ke khate mein pahunchti hai.SWAYAM, DIKSHA tatha E-Pathshala padhai ke platform hain tatha vritti ke aavedan ka kaam unka nahi hai. Exam point: sarkari chhatravritti ke liye single window National Scholarship Portal (NSP) hai - yahi aavedan tatha bhugtan dono ki suvidha deta hai.

qe: The 'PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana' (PM-KMY) provides a monthly pension of how much?
qh: 'पीएम-किसान मानधन योजना' (PM-KMY) कितनी मासिक पेंशन प्रदान करती है?
e: PM-KMY (Kisan Maandhan Yojana) mein patra kisaan sath varsh ki umar ke baad har mahine teen hazaar rupaye paata hai; is kosh mein kisaan tatha sarkar dono barabar rakam jama karte hain. Yah vyavastha isliye banayi gayi ki badhape par kisaan ke paas karz tatha bechne wali sampatti na rahe, isliye yahi pension unhe har mahine ka sahara deti hai; panjikaran ke samay hi KCC tatha aadhaar ka upyog hota hai. 1,000 ya 5,000 rupaye wale vikalp is yojana ki sahi rakam nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PM-KMY wale kosh se buzurg kisaan ko do hazaar se paanch hazaar rupaye ke beech shuru hone wali har-mahine ki sahayata milti hai.

qe: What is the focus of the 'Deep Ocean Mission'?
qh: 'डीप ओशियन मिशन' का फोकस क्या है?
e: Deep Ocean Mission ka dhyan samundar ki gehrai mein chhupe khazane tatha jeevon (biodiversity) ko khojne par hai; ismein 'Matsya 6000' jaisa yantra tatha samundri khanan ki taknik bhi shamil hai. Yah abhiyan isliye shuru hua ki samundar ke abhyantar mein khane wale tel, dhaatu tatha dawaon ke payde ho sakte hain tatha jalvayu parivartan ka asar samundar par samajhna zaroori tha; ismein 'Samudrayaan' tatha 'Ocean Acidification' ke adhyayan bhi aate hain. Naval prashikshan, samundri taton ki safai ya paani ke neeche surang banan is mission ka kaam nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Deep Ocean Mission samundar ke gehare hisse ke srot tatha jeevon par kendra hai - yahi Matsya 6000 jaisi taknik se khoj karta hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to ensure 'Clean Energy' through ethanol blending in petrol?
qh: पेट्रोल में इथेनॉल सम्मिश्रण के माध्यम से 'स्वच्छ ऊर्जा' सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: E20 Programme ka lakshya petroal mein 20 pratishat ethanil (ethanol) milana 2025-26 tak tay karna hai; isse desh ki tel aayat tatha pradushan dono ghatane ki soch hai. Yah karyakram isliye aage badhaya gaya ki cheeni tatha anaaj ke atirikt hisse se ethanil bana sakte hain, jisse kisaanon ko naya bazaar tatha videshi mudra ki bachat hoti hai; iske tehat dehati tatha shehri dono jagah padarth tatha machine lagayi ja rahi hai. UJALA LED bulb, National Green Hydrogen Mission hydrogen tatha saur pump wali yojana alag kaam ke hain, isliye wo teeno alag hain. Exam point: E20 Programme petroal mein 20 pratishat ethanil milane ka lakshya rakhta hai - yahi tel aayat tatha pradushan ghatata hai.

qe: The 'PM-Vidyalaxmi' scheme is related to which sector?
qh: 'पीएम-विद्यालक्ष्मी' योजना किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
e: PM-Vidyalaxmi yojana uchch shiksha (higher education) ke liye karz tatha chhatravritti se judi hai; iske tehat acche sansthanon mein padhne wale patra chhatra ko byaj par chhoot wala education loan tatha vrittii milti hai. Yah yojana isliye layi gayi ki kai chhatra fees ke karan achhi padhai chhod dete hain, isliye karz ki suvidha se unka paisa ka jhijhak khatam hota hai tatha unke sapne poore hote hain. Prathmik school, mid-day meal ya teacher training wale vikalp is yojana ke sahi kshetra nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PM-Vidyalaxmi yojana uchch shiksha ke karz tatha chhatravritti se judi hai - yahi kam aay wale chhatra ko aage padhne ka mauka deti hai.

qe: What is the maximum investment limit in 'Senior Citizen Savings Scheme' (SCSS) as per 2023 budget?
qh: 2023 के बजट के अनुसार 'वरिष्ठ नागरिक बचत योजना' (SCSS) में अधिकतम निवेश सीमा क्या है?
e: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS) mein 2023 ke baad pratyek varsh mein jama ki adhiktam seema 30 lakh rupaye kar di gayi thi; pehle yahi seema 15 lakh rupaye thi tatha iske tehat 60 varsh se adhik aayu wale log khata khol sakte hain. Yah seema badhane ki wajah yahi thi ki buzurg nagrikon ke paas bachat bade roop mein hoti hai par surakshit tatha achhi byaj wala vikalp kam padta tha, isliye yahi yojana unhe bank tatha post office ke zariye surakshit aay deti hai. Solah, bees tatha pachaas lakh ke aankde is seema se alag hain; tees lakh hi sahi seema hai. Exam point: SCSS mein adhiktam nivesh ki seema 30 lakh rupaye hai - yahi buzurg nagrikon ki surakshit bachat yojana hai.

qe: Which mission focuses on the development of 'Inland Waterways' for cargo movement?
qh: माल की आवाजाही के लिए 'अंतर्देशीय जलमार्ग' के विकास पर कौन सा मिशन केंद्रित है?
e: Jal Marg Vikas Project ka dhyan antardeshiy jal margon ke vikas par hai; iske tehat rashtriya jal marg-1 (Ganga) par Varanasi, Sahibganj tatha Haldia mein bandargah tatha nadi ki gehrai jaisa kaam hota hai.
